@@ -38,3 +38,40 @@ CP addresses these tradeoffs. With CP, each GPU computes on part of the sequence
 CP support is included on the GPT code path. Other models that share that path, such as LLaMA, can use CP as well. CP works with TP (tensor model parallelism), PP (pipeline model parallelism), and DP (data parallelism). The total GPU count is TP × CP × PP × DP. CP also works with different attention variants, including MHA, MQA, and GQA, with unidirectional or bidirectional masking.
 
 Enable CP by setting `context_parallel_size=<CP_SIZE>` on the command line. The default `context_parallel_size` is 1, which disables CP. Running with CP requires Megatron Core (>=0.5.0) and Transformer Engine (>=1.1).
+
+## Dynamic context parallelism
+
+Dynamic CP assigns a CP group to each packed microbatch according to its sequence
+lengths. Short sequences can use CP1 while longer sequences share the same DP×CP
+domain at CP2, CP4, and other enabled sizes. The model's build-time group remains
+unchanged. Enable it with `--dynamic-context-parallel --use-varlen-dataset
+--sequence-packing-scheduler default_dynamic_cp --calculate-per-token-loss`, and
+set `--max-seqlen-per-dp-cp-rank` to the token capacity of one rank.
+`--min-dynamic-context-parallel-size` sets the smallest group the scheduler may
+select (default 1). The largest selectable group spans the DP×CP domain; there is
+currently no independent maximum-size option.
+
+GPT and Hybrid models propagate the selected groups through packed microbatch
+metadata. Runtime CP is supported by standard attention, MLA and absorbed MLA,
+DSA with the MLA path, Mamba, GDN/GDN2, GDP, hybrid layout conversion, and MTP.
+Sequence parallelism also carries the matching TP×CP group. CSA and DSA-GQA do
+not support dynamic CP; DeepSeek-V4 is not supported.
+
+The following constraints apply:
+
+- Use per-token loss and variable-length packed training data. Dynamic CP does
+  not support deterministic mode, CUDA graphs, or router z-loss.
+- Headwise Mamba, GDP, and GDN/GDN2 require their TP-local head/group geometry
+  to divide **every** CP size the scheduler can select. Construction validates
+  this against the caller's DP×CP group, before a long sequence reaches forward.
+- Mamba does not support chunkwise CP. Chunkwise GDP keeps all TP-local heads,
+  avoids the head-sharding divisibility restriction, and is recommended when
+  dynamic CP would select more ranks than the head geometry supports.
+- Inference uses CP1. These runtime training groups do not enable CP inference.
+
+MTP with `--calculate-per-token-loss` sums the main and MTP valid-token counts
+over the effective CP group before scaling gradients. This also corrects static
+CP>1 runs whose ranks have different valid-token counts; it adds a two-element
+all-reduce per MTP depth per microbatch. Logged `mtp_N loss` is a global
+token-weighted mean, including under static CP, so packed or masked runs may log
+different values from older mean-of-microbatch-means metrics.

@@ -0,0 +1,266 @@
+# MIMO with dynamic context parallelism
+
+MIMO can encode media independently on colocated or disjoint encoder ranks,
+then route projected features into packs selected by the existing
+sequence-packing scheduler. The encoder and decoder need not share a data
+partition. An image is encoded on one producer; its projected rows can be
+consumed by several context-parallel ranks.
+
+The execution contract uses TP=PP=1, no GTP or expert GTP weight sharding,
+packed THD input, per-token loss, and non-overlapped DDP.
+Each decoder round partitions the decoder domain into disjoint CP packs.
+The transport domain also includes encoder ranks; colocated execution uses the
+same ranks for both roles. Pipeline parallelism and rerun are not supported.
+
+## Public components
+
+| API | Responsibility |
+| --- | --- |
+| `MimoModel.encode_modalities()` | Run the registered encoders/projectors and retain their graphs. |
+| `planning.MediaTask`, `assign_media_to_producers()` | Assign whole media tasks using caller-provided costs and compute producer row offsets. |
+| `planning.build_round_plans()` | Associate ordered media references with scheduled decoder packs. |
+| `comm.pack_bridge.PackFeatureBridge` | Gather features to each pack leader using P2P, broadcast within that CP group, and return gradients along the saved reverse route. |
+| `packing.prepare_mimo_step()` | Reuse the scheduler and THD pack builder, place positions at final physical offsets, and select explicit runtime groups. |
+| `runtime.MimoStepRuntime` | Own one source step's encoder graph, pending transfer and FP32 gradient accumulation. |
+| `runtime.LazyMimoStepRuntime` | Encode independent media chunks on first use and release each graph after its last consumer. |
+
+Use module-level imports for planning, packing and runtime. Importing the base
+model does not load the packing/data-scheduler implementation.
+
+## Source ownership and metadata
+
+Every transport rank currently receives the same ordered CPU mapping of source
+samples and media descriptors. Only decoder ranks call `prepare_mimo_step()`
+and materialize token tensors and THD packs on GPU. This replicated-source
+contract is separate from encoder execution: each producer encodes only its
+assigned media. CPU media preprocessing and materialization remain the caller's
+responsibility; the current source adapter repeats them across both roles.
+Rank-local datasets such as Energon need an acquisition/materialization adapter
+before calling these APIs. The text-only reroute schema cannot carry arbitrary
+media tensors or descriptors.
+
+Samples contain `tokens`, `labels`, `loss_mask`, `position_ids`,
+`original_seq_len`, `padded_seq_len`, and ordered `media_ids`. Stable sample and
+media identities may be any hashable values. Scheduler-local indices do not
+replace these identities. Token fields have the physical sample length;
+positions can be `[S]` or `[axes, S]` and retain their original values.
+
+Logical boundaries, physical offsets, padding masks and supervision masks have
+different meanings. Preparation sanitizes padding, applies the existing packing
+alignment, then places true positions at the final physical offsets. It returns
+complete packs. **Combine text and modality embeddings before one unified CP
+partition**; do not feed an already CP-local text batch back through MIMO.
+The partition preserves the model's linear/attention layouts and their masks.
+
+Pass pre-created `cp_groups` indexed by CP size for the current rank, using
+`ProcessGroupCollection.dynamic_cp` for dynamic CP or the configured static CP
+group. Include an explicit singleton when CP1 is enabled. Preparation validates
+actual ranks against the feature plan. TP1 uses the same groups for TP x CP
+unless matching groups are provided explicitly. Preparation never creates
+groups or changes configuration.
+
+`MimoStepPlan` reports source sample count, supervised token count, source length
+statistics, and the actual `rounds`. The data adapter owns input-bin accounting
+and resume progress. Neither source global-batch size nor consumed input bins
+may be inferred from the number of decoder rounds.
+
+## Explicit forward/backward lifetime
+
+The following shows the colocated host lifecycle:
+
+```python
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.packing import prepare_mimo_step
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.runtime import LazyMimoStepRuntime
+
+# Construct MimoModel(..., external_feature_transport=True) with the encoder's
+# own process groups. The caller supplies media processing and source acquisition.
+plan = prepare_mimo_step(
+    samples,
+    feature_slices,
+    scheduler=scheduler,
+    domain_ranks=domain_ranks,
+    cp_groups=cp_groups,
+    config=model.config,
+    device=device,
+)
+runtime = LazyMimoStepRuntime(transport_group)
+runtime.begin_lazy_step(
+    [item.feature_plans for item in plan.rounds],
+    feature_slices,
+    # Materialize only these media IDs, returning projected rows in their order.
+    lambda media_ids: model.encode_modalities(prepare_media(media_ids))[modality_name],
+    torch.empty((0, hidden_size), device=device, dtype=feature_dtype),
+    forward_only=False,
+)
+
+for item in plan.rounds:
+    transfer = runtime.route(item.feature_plans, item.cp_group)
+    output, loss_mask = wrapped_model(
+        **item.model_inputs,
+        modality_embeddings={modality_name: transfer.features},
+    )
+    # The host computes its ordinary loss and completes decoder backward here.
+    host_decoder_backward(output, loss_mask)
+    runtime.complete_round(transfer)
+
+runtime.finish_backward()
+host_finalize_model_grads()
+```
+
+Media sharing a producer and first/last consumer rounds form one encoder chunk.
+The runtime invokes its callback at first use, accumulates feature gradients in
+FP32, and runs encoder backward immediately after the final consumer. Media
+reused across rounds retain their own graph until then. The packing plan and
+producer assignments do not change. Each callback must create an independent
+graph and preserve media boundaries; chunking assumes media can be encoded
+independently. Exact slice aliases share computation; partially overlapping
+media slices are rejected.
+
+Shared media can make chunk backward order differ from forward order. The
+encoder must accumulate parameter gradients in completion order; first-forward
+flags must not overwrite earlier contributions. Quantized encoder weight caches
+and gradient-overwrite flags require host-specific handling and validation.
+
+Empty producers supply `[0, hidden]` in the common device/dtype. They still call
+the same rounds. For evaluation, pass `forward_only=True`, complete each round
+after forward, then call `finish_forward()`. Execution mode is explicit;
+`features.grad is None` is a valid zero contribution, not a completion signal.
+The runtime rejects a second pending route, stale/duplicate completion handles,
+and finishing before all declared rounds have completed.
+
+Ordinary P2P does not connect autograd graphs. The transport returns detached
+decoder leaves and explicitly applies the transpose of its forward route:
+CP contributions are **summed**, repeated producer slices are added, and the
+runtime accumulates contributions in FP32 before each chunk's encoder backward.
+There is no extra CP/DP/token averaging at the feature boundary. The host performs normal
+parameter-gradient reduction and loss normalization afterward.
+
+`MimoStepRuntime.begin_step(features, num_rounds, forward_only=...)` remains
+available for callers that already encoded a whole source step. It retains that
+graph and runs one encoder backward at `finish_backward()`.
+
+## Megatron training adapter
+
+`examples/mimo/training/packed_step.py` provides `PackedMimoStep`. Its
+`prepare_source` callback returns samples, feature slices and a callable mapping
+ordered media IDs to local encoder inputs. The adapter uses lazy execution for
+this contract; returning an input dictionary retains whole-step encoding.
+The example CLI names this choice
+`--mimo-dcp-encoder-schedule {whole-step,per-round}` (default: `whole-step`).
+Model/data adapters map the selected schedule to the corresponding input contract.
+Both modes plan the complete source batch before execution. `per-round` describes
+encoder execution granularity; it does not itself imply overlap between GPU pools.
+The callback owns dataset/model-specific policies. Call `install()`
+explicitly to register the packing adapter and gradient-finalization wrapper.
+The adapter defaults to the caller's process-group collection for runtime CP
+groups; an explicit `cp_groups` mapping remains supported. The public core
+runtime itself never installs hooks. External source iterators use
+`--dataloader-type external`; the native scheduler still selects packing and
+CP sizes before the data adapter prepares model inputs.
+
+The adapter uses the existing native PP1 schedule: the next forward callback
+returns the previous round's visual gradients and completes any finished encoder
+chunks. The finalizer completes the last round before native gradient
+finalization. Parameter gradients accumulate across all chunks, with one normal
+optimizer update per source step. Evaluation
+cleans up after the final forward rather than relying on a loss closure.
+`examples/mimo/data/source_batch.py` supplies a deterministic replicated-source
+iterator whose resume position is derived from consumed source samples.
+
+Save checkpoints only at a complete source-step boundary. Pending transfers and
+encoder graphs are transient and are not checkpoint state. Native MTP and MoE
+auxiliary objectives retain their existing semantics; changing pack composition
+does not promise identical auxiliary losses.
+
+## Disaggregated native training
+
+`examples/mimo/pretrain_mimo.py --mimo-packed` uses disjoint encoder and decoder
+pools. The model provider supplies source-batch loading, media preparation and
+optional weight initialization through `MimoProvider` callbacks. The packed entry
+builds the configured native tokenizer and saves its assets with checkpoints;
+use `NullTokenizer` for synthetic pretokenized fixtures.
+
+Let **E** be the encoder ranks, **D** the decoder ranks, and **T = E ∪ D** the
+transport domain. The encoder/projector runs on E with independent DP; only D
+owns the decoder, its EP groups and its runtime CP groups. Construct the core
+bridge/runtime with explicit `producer_ranks=E` and `decoder_ranks=D`;
+omitting these arguments retains colocated behavior. Packs cover D exactly.
+Producer-only transfers have no local decoder plan, features or CP operations.
+
+For example, launch **20 GPU processes** with E on ranks 0–3 and D on ranks 4–19.
+Add the following to the model provider, dataset, tokenizer, optimizer and
+recomputation flags, using `pretrain_mimo.py` as the entry:
+
+```bash
+--mimo-packed --mimo-encoder-tp 1 --mimo-encoder-dp 4 \
+--mimo-llm-offset 4 --mimo-llm-tp 1 --mimo-llm-pp 1 \
+--mimo-llm-dp 2 --mimo-llm-cp 8 --mimo-llm-ep 16 --mimo-llm-expt-tp 1 \
+--bf16 --use-distributed-optimizer --optimizer adam \
+--calculate-per-token-loss --dataloader-type external \
+--dynamic-context-parallel --sequence-packing-scheduler default_dynamic_cp \
+--max-seqlen-per-dp-cp-rank 8192 --rerun-mode disabled
+```
+
+CP8 is the decoder's base layout; dynamic CP schedules across all 16 decoder
+ranks. The 8192-token limit constrains each decoder rank, not the whole sample
+or the encoder. Use `dp_balanced` without `--dynamic-context-parallel` for a
+static-CP packing configuration. Native MoE auxiliary losses and MTP remain
+enabled through their usual model flags and keep their existing semantics.
+
+The supported disaggregated path requires BF16, encoder TP=CP=PP=1, decoder
+TP=PP=1, distributed Adam, and no GTP rematerialization. DDP/parameter-gather
+overlap, MoE communication overlap, the separate frozen-encoder prefetch loader,
+and rerun are disabled. Projectors stay on E.
+
+With `--mimo-dcp-encoder-schedule whole-step` (default), the encoder retains one
+source step's activation graph until all decoder rounds return their gradients,
+then executes backward once. Adapters supporting `per-round` return the same
+ordered-media callback used by the colocated adapter. Encoder ranks send the
+current round, backward completed graphs from the preceding round, pre-encode
+the next round, and then collect the current round's feature gradients. Local
+encoder forward/backward can thus overlap the decoder's native forward/backward
+on disjoint GPUs. The decoder schedule and the global packing plan are unchanged.
+There is one pending feature transfer, at most one completed round awaiting
+encoder backward, and one round of prefetch. Shared media graphs remain live
+through their last consumer. The final encoder backward drains before native
+gradient finalization and the optimizer update; evaluation releases graphs
+without gradient messages. Reduced batching may offset overlap gains, so measure
+whole-step time and peak memory for the workload.
+
+Each pack's complete features are gathered to its leader and replicated within
+that CP group; this is not selective transmission to individual token owners.
+
+The adapter preserves native DDP, optimizer and checkpoint handling. Encoder
+and decoder parameter gradients use SUM reductions over their own domains,
+then both divide by the same global decoder supervision-token count. There is
+no active-encoder averaging. Save/resume is supported at idle source-step
+boundaries; in-flight transfers and activation graphs are not checkpointed.
+
+## Validation
+
+Run distributed tests using the repository's standard torch distributed runner.
+The model, partition, transport, runtime and packed-step tests run on four ranks.
+`test_multisample_multiimage_cp8.py` additionally requires **16 colocated ranks**
+or **20 disjoint ranks (E4/D16)**, covering
+multi-image samples sharing CP8 alongside CP4 packs, with producers outside the
+consumer group and image rows crossing CP ranks. Smaller allocations skip that
+case and do not constitute its validation.
+
+The runtime test additionally uses eight ranks for disjoint E4/D4, static and
+dynamic CP, multi-image packs, empty producers and text-only steps. The native
+fixture at `tests/functional_tests/test_cases/mimo/disagg_dcp/run.py` exercises
+the complete `pretrain_mimo.py` loop with a small ViT, MoE/MTP decoder and native
+checkpoint restoration. These are validation targets, not a claim that every
+listed configuration has passed end-to-end testing.
+
+The functional runner at
+`tests/functional_tests/test_cases/mimo/colocated_dcp/run.py` exercises a small
+real ViT and MoE decoder with MTP, native DDP, distributed Adam, and distributed
+checkpoint restoration. Run it with four ranks and `--layout cp1`,
+`--layout static_cp2`, or `--layout dcp`; `--steps` is the final source-step
+index, including after `--load`. It uses the native core schedule through the
+example adapter, rather than the complete `pretrain()` application loop. Its
+results qualify that generic model and execution contract, not a complete
+production model, dataset adapter, or performance improvement.

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Source-global-batch iteration for replicated multimodal example datasets."""
+
+
+class SourceBatchIterator:
+    """Resume a deterministic dataset at a complete source-global-batch boundary.
+
+    The dataset implements ``build_global_batch(step, global_batch_size)`` and
+    returns ``(samples, media)``. This is an example dataset contract, independent
+    of the core runtime and the number of decoder rounds selected by packing.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, dataset, global_batch_size, consumed_samples=0) -> None:
+        if global_batch_size <= 0 or consumed_samples < 0 or consumed_samples % global_batch_size:
+            raise ValueError("MIMO resume requires a complete source global batch")
+        self.dataset = dataset
+        self.global_batch_size = global_batch_size
+        self.step = consumed_samples // global_batch_size
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __next__(self):
+        samples, media = self.dataset.build_global_batch(self.step, self.global_batch_size)
+        result = dict(step=self.step, samples=samples, media=media)
+        self.step += 1
+        return result

+"""Disjoint-role adapter for native packed MIMO training."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from examples.mimo.training.packed_step import PackedMimoStep
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.config.role import MIMO_LANGUAGE_MODULE_KEY
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.packing import prepare_mimo_step
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.runtime import LazyMimoStepRuntime, MimoStepRuntime
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.schedules import forward_backward_no_pipelining
+from megatron.core.rerun_state_machine import RerunDataIterator

+
+class PackedDisaggMimoStep(PackedMimoStep):
+    """Reuse the decoder's native PP1 schedule, with explicit encoder participants.
+
+    All roles prepare one source batch. Only decoder ranks pack it; their leader
+    publishes the immutable per-round routes. Encoder ranks execute those routes
+    without a decoder loss. Whole-step encoding retains one graph until finalization;
+    per-round encoding overlaps local encoder work with the current decoder round.
+    Both use the existing heterogeneous finalizer and optimizer once per source step.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, model, topology, prepare_source, *, modality_name):
+        self.is_decoder = model.role.has_language_module
+        name = MIMO_LANGUAGE_MODULE_KEY if self.is_decoder else modality_name
+        super().__init__(
+            model,
+            topology.module_pgs[name],
+            prepare_source,
+            topology.cp_groups,
+            modality_name=modality_name,
+        )
+        self.decoder_ranks = tuple(
+            sorted(
+                rank
+                for line in topology.grids[MIMO_LANGUAGE_MODULE_KEY].get_rank_enum("pp")
+                for rank in line
+            )
+        )
+        producers = tuple(
+            sorted(
+                rank for line in topology.grids[modality_name].get_rank_enum("pp") for rank in line
+            )
+        )
+        self.producer_ranks = producers
+        self.runtime = MimoStepRuntime(
+            dist.group.WORLD, producer_ranks=producers, decoder_ranks=self.decoder_ranks
+        )
+        self._finalize_grads = model.config.finalize_model_grads_func
+        self.routes = None
+
+    def install(self, **kwargs):
+        super().install(**kwargs)
+        self.model.config.forward_backward_func = self.run
+        if not self.is_decoder:
+            # The host constructs an unused scheduler before calling the data adapter.
+            # Its encoder-local size must not constrain the decoder's minimum CP.
+            self.model.config.min_dynamic_context_parallel_size = 1
+
+    def prepare(self, data_iterator, num_microbatches, scheduler, pg_collection):
+        if self.runtime.active:
+            raise RuntimeError("The previous MIMO source step has not finished")
+        samples, slices, inputs = self.prepare_source(next(data_iterator))
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        self.plan = (
+            prepare_mimo_step(
+                samples,
+                slices,
+                scheduler=scheduler,
+                domain_ranks=self.decoder_ranks,
+                cp_groups=self.cp_groups,
+                config=self.model.config,
+                device=device,
+            )
+            if self.is_decoder
+            else None
+        )
+        # Only control metadata crosses the whole job. Features use directed P2P.
+        message = [None]
+        if dist.get_rank() == self.decoder_ranks[0]:
+            message[0] = (
+                tuple(item.feature_plans for item in self.plan.rounds),
+                self.plan.source_tokens,
+                self.plan.source_tokens_squared,
+                not self.model.training,
+                callable(inputs),
+            )
+        dist.broadcast_object_list(message, src=self.decoder_ranks[0])
+        self.routes, tokens, squared, forward_only, per_round = message[0]
+        if forward_only != (not self.model.training):
+            raise RuntimeError("Encoder and decoder execution modes disagree")
+        if per_round != callable(inputs):
+            raise RuntimeError("Encoder and decoder input contracts disagree")
+        runtime_type = LazyMimoStepRuntime if per_round else MimoStepRuntime
+        if type(self.runtime) is not runtime_type:
+            self.runtime = runtime_type(
+                dist.group.WORLD,
+                producer_ranks=self.producer_ranks,
+                decoder_ranks=self.decoder_ranks,
+            )
+            self.model.mimo_step_runtime = self.runtime
+        empty = torch.empty(
+            (0, self.model.config.hidden_size), device=device, dtype=self.model.config.params_dtype
+        )
+        if per_round:
+            encoder_autocast = torch.is_autocast_enabled("cuda")
+            encoder_autocast_dtype = torch.get_autocast_dtype("cuda")
+
+            def encode(media_ids):
+                with torch.autocast("cuda", enabled=encoder_autocast, dtype=encoder_autocast_dtype):
+                    return self.model.encode_modalities(inputs(media_ids)).get(
+                        self.modality_name, empty
+                    )
+
+            self.runtime.begin_lazy_step(
+                self.routes, slices, encode, empty, forward_only=forward_only
+            )

+            self._begin_whole_step(inputs, slices, empty, forward_only)
+        items = self.plan.rounds if self.is_decoder else self.routes
+        return RerunDataIterator(iter(items)), len(self.routes), float(tokens), float(squared)
+
+    def _begin_whole_step(self, inputs, slices, empty, forward_only):
+        """Validate the eager feature contract collectively before entering transport."""
+        device = empty.device
+        with torch.set_grad_enabled(not forward_only):
+            encoded = self.model.encode_modalities(inputs) if not self.is_decoder else {}

+            (
+                piece.offset + piece.length
+                for piece in slices.values()
+                if piece.producer_rank == dist.get_rank()
+            ),
+            default=0,
+        )

+            int(
+                features.shape != (expected, self.model.config.hidden_size)
+                or features.dtype != self.model.config.params_dtype
+                or features.device != device
+            ),
+            device=device,
+        )
+        dist.all_reduce(invalid, op=dist.ReduceOp.MAX)
+        if invalid.item():
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Encoder output shape, dtype or device disagrees with the media contract"
+            )
+        self.runtime.begin_step(features, len(self.routes), forward_only=forward_only)
+
+    def run(self, *, model, data_iterator, num_microbatches, forward_only=False, **kwargs):
+        """Keep the native decoder schedule; encoder-only ranks service its rounds."""
+        if not self.runtime.active or num_microbatches != self.runtime.num_rounds:

+                data_iterator=data_iterator,
+                num_microbatches=num_microbatches,
+                forward_only=forward_only,

+            )

+                barrier=self.model.config.barrier_with_L1_time

+            if isinstance(self.runtime, LazyMimoStepRuntime):

+                self.runtime.prefetch_next_round()
+                self.runtime.complete_round(transfer, defer_encoder_backward=True)
+            else:
+                self.runtime.complete_round(transfer)

+            self.runtime.finish_forward()
+            self.routes = None

+            self.finalize(
+                model,
+                torch.zeros((), dtype=torch.int, device="cuda"),
+                force_all_reduce=kwargs.get("force_all_reduce", False),
+            )
+        if timers is not None:
+            timers('forward-backward').stop()
+        return []
+
+    def finalize(self, model, num_tokens=None, **kwargs):
+        if self.runtime.pending is not None:
+            self.runtime.complete_round(self.runtime.pending)
+        self.runtime.finish_backward()
+        self.plan = self.routes = None
+        self._finalize_grads(model, num_tokens, **kwargs)

+
+"""Thin PP1 Megatron training adapter for the public MIMO packing/runtime APIs."""
+
+from functools import partial
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from megatron.core.distributed.finalize_model_grads import finalize_model_grads
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.packing import prepare_mimo_step
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.runtime import LazyMimoStepRuntime, MimoStepRuntime
+from megatron.core.rerun_state_machine import RerunDataIterator
+from megatron.core.utils import get_attr_wrapped_model
+
+
+class PackedMimoStep:
+    """Adapt a replicated source-global-batch iterator to the native PP1 schedule.
+
+    ``prepare_source(source)`` is supplied by the model/data adapter and returns
+    ``(samples, feature_slices, encoder_inputs)`` for this rank. ``encoder_inputs``
+    can be a callable accepting ordered media IDs to materialize on first use,
+    or an already prepared input dict for whole-step encoding. The source owns
+    media processing and assignment; packing and graph lifetimes belong to core.
+    One adapter handles one named modality.
+
+    The constructor does not change config. Call ``install`` explicitly after
+    model construction. Ordinary decoder backward, DDP, optimizer and checkpoint
+    behavior remain in the host training loop.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model,
+        pg_collection,
+        prepare_source,
+        cp_groups=None,
+        *,
+        modality_name,
+        tp_cp_groups=None,
+    ) -> None:
+        config = model.config
+        if pg_collection.tp.size() != 1 or pg_collection.pp.size() != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Colocated MIMO packing currently requires TP=PP=1")
+        if config.gtp_weight_remat_size != 1 or config.expert_gtp_weight_remat_size != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Colocated MIMO packing does not support GTP or expert GTP")
+        if not config.calculate_per_token_loss or not config.sequence_packing_scheduler:
+            raise ValueError("Colocated MIMO requires packed scheduling and per-token loss")
+        if cp_groups is None:
+            cp_groups = (
+                pg_collection.dynamic_cp
+                if config.dynamic_context_parallel
+                else {pg_collection.cp.size(): pg_collection.cp}
+            )
+        self.model, self.pg = model, pg_collection
+        self.prepare_source = prepare_source

+def _routes(plans):
+    """Yield a deterministic message per (pack, producer), preserving row order."""
+    for plan in plans:
+        producers = {}
+        target_offset = 0
+        for feature in plan.features:
+            if feature.length:
+                producers.setdefault(feature.producer_rank, []).append((feature, target_offset))
+            target_offset += feature.length
+        for producer, pieces in sorted(producers.items()):
+            yield plan.cp_ranks[0], producer, pieces

+
+def _wait_p2p(operations):

+        for work in dist.batch_isend_irecv(operations):
+            work.wait()

+    a rank with no images still participates.

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+"""Plan projected media rows independently of decoder packing and CP ownership.
+
+These helpers operate on replicated descriptors, not media tensors. Callers own
+media preparation and cost estimates; the existing packing scheduler owns sample
+assignments. Sample and media identities need only be hashable, not contiguous
+integers. Every rank must supply descriptors in the same order.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from math import isfinite
+from typing import Any, Hashable, Mapping, Sequence
+
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.comm.pack_bridge import FeatureSlice, PackFeaturePlan
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MediaTask:
+    """One independently encoded media item with a caller-provided cost estimate.
+
+    ``length`` is the number of projected rows consumed by the decoder. Tasks
+    have unique identities; a sample may reference the same task more than once.
+    """
+
+    media_id: Hashable
+    length: int
+    cost: float = 1.0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EncoderChunk:
+    """Whole media with the same producer and first/last decoder consumers.
+
+    The encoder returns rows in ``media_ids`` order. Its independent graph can
+    be released after ``last_round``, even when other chunks remain live.
+    """
+
+    producer_rank: int
+    first_round: int
+    last_round: int
+    media_ids: tuple[Hashable, ...]
+    features: tuple[FeatureSlice, ...]
+
+    @property
+    def num_rows(self) -> int:
+        """Number of projected rows in the encoder output."""
+        return sum(feature.length for feature in self.features)
+
+
+def plan_encoder_chunks(
+    rounds: Sequence[Sequence[PackFeaturePlan]], feature_slices: Mapping[Hashable, FeatureSlice]
+) -> tuple[EncoderChunk, ...]:
+    """Group source media by graph lifetime without changing producer assignment.
+
+    Exact duplicate slices alias the same media computation; the first media ID
+    is canonical. Partial overlaps and sub-media references are rejected because
+    their independent encoder graph boundaries would otherwise be ambiguous.
+    """
+    media_by_slice = {}
+    for media_id, feature in feature_slices.items():
+        if feature.offset < 0 or feature.length <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Encoder media need nonnegative offsets and positive lengths")
+        media_by_slice.setdefault(feature, media_id)
+    previous = {}
+    for feature in sorted(media_by_slice, key=lambda item: (item.producer_rank, item.offset)):
+        if feature.offset < previous.get(feature.producer_rank, 0):
+            raise ValueError("Encoder media slices must not partially overlap")
+        previous[feature.producer_rank] = feature.offset + feature.length
+
+    lifetimes = {}
+    for index, plans in enumerate(rounds):
+        for plan in plans:
+            for feature in plan.features:
+                if feature not in media_by_slice:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "Each decoder feature must reference a whole known media slice"
+                    )
+                lifetime = lifetimes.setdefault(feature, [index, index])
+                lifetime[1] = index
+    chunks = {}
+    for feature, media_id in media_by_slice.items():
+        if feature in lifetimes:
+            first, last = lifetimes[feature]
+            chunks.setdefault((feature.producer_rank, first, last), []).append((media_id, feature))
+    return tuple(
+        EncoderChunk(
+            producer,
+            first,
+            last,
+            tuple(media_id for media_id, _ in media),
+            tuple(feature for _, feature in media),
+        )
+        for (producer, first, last), media in chunks.items()
+    )
+
+
+def assign_media_to_producers(
+    tasks: Sequence[MediaTask], producer_ranks: Sequence[int]
+) -> tuple[dict[int, list[MediaTask]], dict[Hashable, FeatureSlice]]:
+    """Greedily balance whole media tasks and establish each producer's row offsets.
+
+    Equal costs use input order, so identities never need to be sortable. Each
+    producer encodes its assigned tasks in their original input order and must
+    concatenate projected rows in that order.
+    """
+    producer_ranks = tuple(producer_ranks)
+    if len(set(producer_ranks)) != len(producer_ranks):
+        raise ValueError("Encoder producer ranks must be unique")
+    if tasks and not producer_ranks:
+        raise ValueError("Media tasks require at least one encoder producer")
+    if len({task.media_id for task in tasks}) != len(tasks):
+        raise ValueError("Each encoder media task must have a unique media ID")
+    if any(
+        not isinstance(task.length, int)
+        or task.length <= 0
+        or not isfinite(task.cost)
+        or task.cost < 0
+        for task in tasks
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Projected row counts must be positive and costs finite and nonnegative")
+
+    indices_by_rank = {rank: [] for rank in producer_ranks}
+    loads = [0.0] * len(producer_ranks)
+    for index in sorted(range(len(tasks)), key=lambda index: (-tasks[index].cost, index)):
+        producer = min(range(len(producer_ranks)), key=lambda rank: (loads[rank], rank))
+        indices_by_rank[producer_ranks[producer]].append(index)
+        loads[producer] += tasks[index].cost
+
+    assignments, feature_slices = {}, {}
+    for rank, indices in indices_by_rank.items():
+        local_tasks = [tasks[index] for index in sorted(indices)]
+        assignments[rank] = local_tasks
+        offset = 0
+        for task in local_tasks:
+            feature_slices[task.media_id] = FeatureSlice(rank, offset, task.length)
+            offset += task.length
+    return assignments, feature_slices
+
+
+def build_round_plans(
+    sample_ids_by_rank: Sequence[Sequence[Hashable]],
+    samples: Mapping[Hashable, Mapping[str, Any]],
+    feature_slices: Mapping[Hashable, FeatureSlice],
+    domain_ranks: Sequence[int],

+    """Join one scheduled decoder round with ordered media references.
+
+    Identical ordered sample tuples identify ranks sharing one decoder pack.
+    ``samples[sample_id]['media_ids']`` follows placeholder order within that

+    validation against actual process-group ranks remain the caller's job.
+    """

+class MimoStepRuntime:
+    """Own one modality's source graph and feature transfers for a source step.
+
+    All transport ranks call the same rounds, including empty producers and
+    text-only consumers. The host runs the encoder and decoder, explicitly
+    completes each round after decoder backward, then calls ``finish_backward``
+    before its normal gradient finalization. This class does not install hooks,
+    normalize gradients, run an optimizer, or infer completion from leaf grads.
+
+    Only one transfer may be pending. Checkpointing is supported at an idle
+    source-step boundary; encoder graphs and pending transfers are not serialized.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        transport_group: ProcessGroup,
+        *,
+        producer_ranks: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None,
+        decoder_ranks: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.bridge = PackFeatureBridge(
+            transport_group, producer_ranks=producer_ranks, decoder_ranks=decoder_ranks
+        )
+        self._clear()
+
+    def _clear(self) -> None:
+        self.local_features = None
+        self.feature_gradient = None
+        self.pending = None
+        self.num_rounds = self.completed_rounds = 0
+        self.forward_only = False
+
+    @property
+    def active(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether an encoder graph or evaluation step is still owned."""
+        return self.local_features is not None
+
+    def begin_step(
+        self, local_features: torch.Tensor, num_rounds: int, *, forward_only: bool
+    ) -> None:
+        """Save projected encoder rows without detaching their original graph.
+
+        Empty producers pass a floating ``[0, hidden]`` tensor on the same device
+        and in the same dtype as other producers. Execution mode is explicit and
+        must agree across the transport domain.
+        """
+        if self.active:
+            raise RuntimeError("Finish the active MIMO source step before beginning another")
+        if local_features.ndim != 2 or not local_features.is_floating_point():
+            raise ValueError("local_features must be a floating-point [rows, hidden] tensor")
+        if num_rounds < 1:
+            raise ValueError("A source step must contain at least one decoder round")
+        self.local_features = local_features
+        self.num_rounds = num_rounds
+        self.forward_only = forward_only
+        if not forward_only:
+            self.feature_gradient = torch.zeros_like(local_features, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    def route(
+        self, plans: Sequence[PackFeaturePlan], cp_group: Optional[ProcessGroup] = None
+    ) -> PackFeatureTransfer:
+        """Route this round's features; never implicitly complete an earlier round."""
+        if not self.active:
+            raise RuntimeError("begin_step must precede feature routing")
+        if self.pending is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Complete the pending feature transfer before routing another")
+        if self.completed_rounds == self.num_rounds:
+            raise RuntimeError("All planned decoder rounds have already completed")
+        self.pending = self.bridge.forward(
+            self.local_features, plans, cp_group, forward_only=self.forward_only
+        )
+        return self.pending
+
+    def complete_round(self, transfer: PackFeatureTransfer) -> None:
+        """After decoder backward, return and accumulate this transfer's gradients.
+
+        A missing leaf gradient contributes zeros, including an unused modality.
+        It does not indicate whether the host has executed backward. Evaluation
+        releases the transfer without running backward communication.
+        """
+        if not self.active or transfer is not self.pending or transfer is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Expected the current pending transfer, not a stale or completed one"
+            )
+        if not self.forward_only:
+            self.feature_gradient.add_(self.bridge.backward(transfer))
+        self.pending = None
+        self.completed_rounds += 1
+
+    def _check_finished(self, *, forward_only: bool) -> None:
+        if not self.active or self.forward_only != forward_only:
+            raise RuntimeError("No active MIMO step in the requested execution mode")
+        if self.pending is not None or self.completed_rounds != self.num_rounds:
+            raise RuntimeError("Explicitly complete every decoder round before finishing the step")
+
+    def finish_backward(self) -> None:
+        """Backpropagate through the encoder once, after every decoder contribution."""
+        self._check_finished(forward_only=False)
+        if self.local_features.requires_grad:
+            self.local_features.backward(self.feature_gradient.to(self.local_features.dtype))
+        self._clear()
+
+    def finish_forward(self) -> None:
+        """Release an evaluation step after all rounds, without a loss-closure hook."""
+        self._check_finished(forward_only=True)
+        self._clear()
+

+class LazyMimoStepRuntime(MimoStepRuntime):
+    """Execute independent encoder chunks only while their consumers need them.

+    def _clear(self) -> None:

+        """Prepare at most one future round on a producer-only rank, without communication.

+        """

+    def route(
+        self, plans: Sequence[PackFeaturePlan], cp_group: Optional[ProcessGroup] = None
+    ) -> PackFeatureTransfer:
+        """Encode first-use chunks and rebase this round's source row offsets."""
+        if not self.active or self.pending is not None or self.completed_rounds == self.num_rounds:
+            raise RuntimeError("Routing requires an active step with no pending or exhausted round")
+        index = self.completed_rounds
+        if tuple(plans) != self.round_plans[index]:
+            raise ValueError("Feature plans must follow the source step's saved round order")
+        active = [chunk for chunk in self.chunks if chunk.first_round <= index <= chunk.last_round]
+        self._round_chunks = tuple(
+            chunk for chunk in active if chunk.producer_rank == self.bridge.rank
+        )
+        self._encode_round(index)

+
+    def complete_round(
+        self, transfer: PackFeatureTransfer, *, defer_encoder_backward: bool = False
+    ) -> None:
+        """Return visual gradients, optionally retaining completed graphs until the next send.
+
+        Deferred graphs belong to one completed round at most. The host must
+        call ``backward_ready`` before completing another round or prefetching.
+        Evaluation releases completed chunks immediately in either mode.
+        """
+        if not self.active or transfer is not self.pending or transfer is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Expected the current pending transfer, not a stale or completed one"

+                    self._ready_backward.append((features, gradient))

+        self.local_features = self.empty_template
+        self._round_chunks = ()
+        self.completed_rounds += 1
+        if not defer_encoder_backward:
+            self.backward_ready()
+
+    def backward_ready(self) -> None:
+        """Backpropagate completed chunks locally, optionally while the next transfer is pending."""
+        if not self.active:

+            features.backward(gradient.to(features.dtype))
+        self._ready_backward.clear()
+
+    def finish_backward(self) -> None:
+        """Drain the last completed chunks before native gradient finalization."""
+        self._check_finished(forward_only=False)
+        if self.live_chunks:
+            raise RuntimeError("Encoder chunks remain live after all decoder rounds")
+        self.backward_ready()
+        self._clear()

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+"""Four-GPU MIMO correctness/health exercise using native schedules and optimizer.
+
+Run with ``torchrun --nproc-per-node=4 .../run.py --layout dcp --steps 50
+--output /path/run.json --save /path/checkpoint``. Resume with ``--load`` and
+the same layout/seed; ``--steps`` is the final source-step index. CP1, static_cp2
+and dcp use identical source batches and initialization. This is a small real
+CLIP/GPT/MoE/MTP model qualification, not a full Qwen or performance benchmark.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import math
+import os
+from copy import copy
+from dataclasses import fields, is_dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from examples.mimo.training.packed_step import PackedMimoStep, forward_step
+from megatron.core import dist_checkpointing, parallel_state
+from megatron.core.datasets.data_schedule import wrap_data_iterator
+from megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.mapping import (
+    LocalNonpersistentObject,
+    ShardedBase,
+    ShardedObject,
+)
+from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel, DistributedDataParallelConfig
+from megatron.core.enums import ModelType
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_layer_specs import (
+    get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec,
+    get_gpt_mtp_block_spec,
+)
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_model import GPTModel
+from megatron.core.models.mimo import MimoModel, MimoModelConfig
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.planning import MediaTask, assign_media_to_producers
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.submodules.vision import VisionModalitySubmodules
+from megatron.core.models.vision.clip_vit_model import CLIPViTModel
+from megatron.core.optimizer import OptimizerConfig, get_megatron_optimizer
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.schedules import get_forward_backward_func
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import (
+    get_cuda_rng_tracker,
+    model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed,
+)
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import Float16Module
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe.moe_logging import get_moe_metrics_tracker
+from megatron.core.transformer.multi_token_prediction import MTPLossLoggingHelper
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+CHECKPOINT_METADATA = {"distrib_optim_sharding_type": "dp_reshardable", "checkpoint_version": 3.1}
+
+
+def build_model(config, pg):
+    """Real one-layer ViT and two-layer MoE decoder, plus a third MoE layer for MTP."""
+    layer = get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec(num_experts=4, moe_grouped_gemm=True)
+    language = ModuleSpec(
+        GPTModel,
+        params=dict(
+            config=config,
+            transformer_layer_spec=layer,
+            mtp_block_spec=get_gpt_mtp_block_spec(config, layer, True, pp_rank=0),
+            vocab_size=256,
+            max_sequence_length=512,
+            position_embedding_type="rope",
+            scatter_embedding_sequence_parallel=False,
+            share_embeddings_and_output_weights=False,
+            pg_collection=pg,
+        ),
+    )
+    encoder_pg = copy(pg)
+    for name in ("tp", "cp", "tp_cp", "ep", "expt_tp", "tp_ep", "tp_ep_pp"):
+        setattr(encoder_pg, name, pg.tp)
+    for name in ("dp", "dp_cp", "dp_gtp_remat", "dp_cp_gtp_remat", "expt_dp", "expt_dp_gtp_remat"):
+        setattr(encoder_pg, name, pg.dp_cp)
+    vision_config = TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=1,
+        hidden_size=64,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        ffn_hidden_size=128,
+        bf16=True,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        use_cpu_initialization=True,
+        hidden_dropout=0,
+        attention_dropout=0,
+    )
+    vision = ModuleSpec(
+        VisionModalitySubmodules,
+        params={"pg_collection": encoder_pg},
+        submodules={
+            "encoders": {
+                "clip": ModuleSpec(
+                    CLIPViTModel,
+                    params=dict(
+                        transformer_config=vision_config,
+                        transformer_layer_spec=get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec(),
+                        img_h=16,
+                        img_w=16,
+                        patch_dim=8,
+                        pg_collection=encoder_pg,
+                    ),
+                )
+            }
+        },
+    )
+    model = MimoModel(
+        MimoModelConfig(
+            language_model_spec=language,
+            modality_submodules_spec={"images": vision},
+            special_token_ids={"images": 255},
+            kv_format="thd",
+        ),
+        cp_group=pg.cp,
+        tp_group=pg.tp,
+        external_feature_transport=True,
+    ).cuda()
+    model.pg_collection = pg
+    model.model_type = ModelType.encoder_or_decoder
+    return model
+
+
+def source_batch(step, seed, domain):
+    """Deterministic multi-image and text-only samples, independent of rank/packing."""
+    samples, tasks = {}, []
+    for sid, length in enumerate((192, 128, 96, 64, 64, 32, 32, 32, 32)):
+        logical = length - 3
+        tokens = (torch.arange(length) + 11 * sid + step % 3) % 127 + 1
+        labels = (tokens % 127) + 1
+        image_count = (3, 2, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0)[sid] if step % 7 != 6 else 0
+        media_ids = [3 * sid + image for image in range(image_count)]
+        tokens[2 : 2 + 5 * image_count] = 255
+        tokens[logical:] = labels[logical:] = 0
+        mask = torch.zeros(length)
+        mask[2 + 5 * image_count : logical] = 1
+        samples[sid] = dict(
+            tokens=tokens,
+            labels=labels,
+            loss_mask=mask,
+            position_ids=torch.arange(logical),
+            original_seq_len=logical,
+            padded_seq_len=length,
+            media_ids=media_ids,
+        )
+        tasks.extend(MediaTask(media_id, 5) for media_id in media_ids)
+    assignments, slices = assign_media_to_producers(tasks, domain)
+    images = {
+        task.media_id: torch.randn(
+            (3, 16, 16), generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed + task.media_id)
+        )
+        for task in assignments[dist.get_rank()]
+    }
+
+    def inputs(media_ids):
+        selected = [images[media_id] for media_id in media_ids]
+        return (
+            {"images": {"clip": {"x": torch.stack(selected).cuda().bfloat16()}}} if selected else {}
+        )
+
+    return samples, slices, inputs, images
+
+
+def fingerprint(value, *, skip_optimizer_padding=False):
+    """Exact local tensor/scalar fingerprint for checkpoint restoration, not CP equivalence."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+
+    def visit(item):
+        if isinstance(item, ShardedBase):
+            visit(item.data)
+        elif isinstance(item, LocalNonpersistentObject):
+            visit(item.unwrap())
+        elif isinstance(item, torch.Tensor):
+            digest.update(str((item.shape, item.dtype)).encode())
+            digest.update(
+                item.detach().reshape(-1).contiguous().view(torch.uint8).cpu().numpy().tobytes()
+            )
+        elif isinstance(item, torch.Generator):
+            visit(item.get_state())
+        elif isinstance(item, io.BytesIO):
+            visit(item.getvalue())
+        elif is_dataclass(item):
+            for field in fields(item):
+                visit(field.name)
+                visit(getattr(item, field.name))
+        elif isinstance(item, dict):
+            padding = item.get("padding")
+            if (
+                skip_optimizer_padding
+                and isinstance(padding, LocalNonpersistentObject)
+                and padding.unwrap() is True
+            ):
+                # dp_reshardable creates uninitialized padding that optimizer load discards.
+                return
+            for key in sorted(item, key=str):
+                visit(key)
+                visit(item[key])
+        elif isinstance(item, (tuple, list)):
+            for child in item:
+                visit(child)
+        elif (
+            isinstance(item, (str, int, float, bool, bytes, torch.dtype, torch.device))
+            or item is None
+        ):
+            digest.update(str(item).encode())
+        else:
+            raise TypeError(f"Unsupported fingerprint value: {type(item)}")
+
+    visit(value)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def check_branch_gradients(model, has_images, group):
+    """Require finite native main_grads and actual vision/MTP participation."""
+    flags = torch.zeros(4, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int)
+    for index, module in enumerate((model.modality_submodules, model.language_model.mtp)):
+        assert module is not None and any(
+            parameter.requires_grad for parameter in module.parameters()
+        )
+        for parameter in module.parameters():
+            if parameter.requires_grad:
+                grad = parameter.main_grad
+                flags[index] |= (~torch.isfinite(grad).all()).int()
+                flags[index + 2] |= grad.ne(0).any().int()
+    dist.all_reduce(flags, op=dist.ReduceOp.MAX, group=group)
+    assert not flags[:2].any(), "Non-finite encoder or MTP gradient"
+    assert flags[3] and (flags[2] or not has_images), "Missing encoder or MTP gradient"
+    return {"vision_nonzero": bool(flags[2]), "mtp_nonzero": bool(flags[3])}
+
+
+def checkpoint_state(model, optimizer, step, args, loading=False):
+    model_state = model.sharded_state_dict()
+    rng = dict(
+        cpu=torch.get_rng_state(),
+        cuda=torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
+        tracker=get_cuda_rng_tracker().get_states(),
+    )
+    return dict(
+        model=model_state,
+        optimizer=optimizer.sharded_state_dict(
+            model_state, is_loading=loading, metadata=CHECKPOINT_METADATA
+        ),
+        step=step,
+        layout=args.layout,
+        seed=args.seed,
+        rng=ShardedObject("rng", rng, (dist.get_world_size(),), (dist.get_rank(),)),
+    )
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--layout", choices=("cp1", "static_cp2", "dcp"), required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=50)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1234)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--save", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--load", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"]))
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl")
+    assert dist.get_world_size() == 4, "This E2E protocol requires four CUDA ranks"
+    cp_size, dynamic = (1 if args.layout == "cp1" else 2), args.layout == "dcp"
+    parallel_state.initialize_model_parallel(
+        context_parallel_size=cp_size,
+        expert_model_parallel_size=4,
+        expert_tensor_parallel_size=1,
+        dynamic_context_parallel=dynamic,
+        create_gloo_process_groups=False,
+    )
+    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+    model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(args.seed)
+    pg = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+    config = TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=2,
+        hidden_size=64,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        ffn_hidden_size=128,
+        bf16=True,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        pipeline_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        use_cpu_initialization=True,
+        hidden_dropout=0,
+        attention_dropout=0,
+        context_parallel_size=cp_size,
+        expert_model_parallel_size=4,
+        num_moe_experts=4,
+        moe_grouped_gemm=True,
+        moe_router_topk=2,
+        moe_token_dispatcher_type="alltoall",
+        moe_router_load_balancing_type="global_aux_loss",
+        moe_aux_loss_coeff=0.01,
+        mtp_num_layers=1,
+        mtp_loss_scaling_factor=0.1,
+        calculate_per_token_loss=True,
+        dynamic_context_parallel=dynamic,
+        sequence_packing_scheduler="default_dynamic_cp" if dynamic else "dp_balanced",
+        max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank={"cp1": 256, "static_cp2": 128, "dcp": 64}[args.layout],
+        pad_packed_seq_alignment="max",
+        recompute_granularity="full",
+        recompute_method="uniform",
+        recompute_num_layers=1,
+    )
+    model = build_model(config, pg)
+    ddp = DistributedDataParallel(
+        config,
+        DistributedDataParallelConfig(
+            grad_reduce_in_fp32=True,
+            use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+            overlap_grad_reduce=False,
+            overlap_param_gather=False,
+            average_in_collective=False,
+        ),
+        Float16Module(config, model),
+        pg_collection=pg,
+    )
+    optimizer = get_megatron_optimizer(
+        OptimizerConfig(
+            optimizer="adam",
+            lr=0.001,
+            min_lr=0.001,
+            weight_decay=0,
+            clip_grad=1.0,
+            bf16=True,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+        ),
+        [ddp],
+        config_overrides={},
+        pg_collection=pg,
+        use_gloo_process_groups=False,
+    )
+    adapter = PackedMimoStep(model, pg, lambda source: source[:3], modality_name="images")
+    adapter.install()
+    start = 0
+    report = dict(
+        layout=args.layout,
+        seed=args.seed,
+        steps=[],
+        initial_model_hash=fingerprint(model.state_dict()),
+    )
+    if args.load:
+        restored = dist_checkpointing.load(
+            checkpoint_state(model, optimizer, 0, args, True), str(args.load), strict="raise_all"
+        )
+        assert (restored["layout"], restored["seed"]) == (args.layout, args.seed)
+        model.load_state_dict(restored["model"], strict=True)
+        optimizer.load_state_dict(restored["optimizer"])
+        torch.set_rng_state(restored["rng"]["cpu"])
+        torch.cuda.set_rng_state(restored["rng"]["cuda"])
+        get_cuda_rng_tracker().set_states(restored["rng"]["tracker"])
+        start = int(restored["step"])
+        restored_state = checkpoint_state(model, optimizer, start, args)
+        saved = json.loads((args.load / f"rank-{dist.get_rank()}-fingerprints.json").read_text())
+        actual = {
+            name: fingerprint(restored_state[name], skip_optimizer_padding=name == "optimizer")
+            for name in ("model", "optimizer", "rng")
+        }
+        assert (
+            actual == saved
+        ), "Checkpoint did not restore all local model/Adam/RNG tensors exactly"
+        report["restore_verified"] = actual
+    if args.steps <= start:
+        raise ValueError("--steps must exceed the restored step (or zero for a fresh run)")
+    schedule = get_forward_backward_func(pp_size=1)
+    for step in range(start, args.steps):
+        ddp.zero_grad_buffer()
+        optimizer.zero_grad()
+        source = source_batch(step, args.seed, dist.get_process_group_ranks(pg.dp_cp))
+        iterator, rounds, _, _ = wrap_data_iterator(iter([source]), config, 1, pg)
+        sizes = [item.cp_group.size() for item in adapter.plan.rounds]
+        losses = schedule(
+            forward_step_func=forward_step,
+            data_iterator=iterator,
+            model=ddp,
+            num_microbatches=rounds,
+            seq_length=512,
+            micro_batch_size=1,
+            pg_collection=pg,
+        )
+        assert not adapter.runtime.active
+        if step == start:
+            report["branch_gradients"] = check_branch_gradients(
+                model, any(sample["media_ids"] for sample in source[0].values()), pg.dp_cp
+            )
+        updated, grad_norm, _ = optimizer.step()
+        assert updated and grad_norm is not None and math.isfinite(float(grad_norm))
+        lm = torch.stack([item["lm loss"] for item in losses]).sum(0)
+        dist.all_reduce(lm, group=pg.dp_cp)
+        MTPLossLoggingHelper.reduce_metrics_in_tracker()
+        mtp = MTPLossLoggingHelper.tracker["loss_values"].mean().item()
+        MTPLossLoggingHelper.clean_metrics_in_tracker()
+        auxiliary = {}

+"""Small disaggregated MIMO fixture through the real native pretrain entry.
+
+Launch with eight ranks (E4/D4, GBS8), or twenty (E4/D16, GBS4) for a real
+CP8 multi-image pack alongside two CP4 packs. All training and checkpoint handling
+remain in ``examples.mimo.pretrain_mimo.main``. This synthetic fixture tests the
+integration; it is not a Qwen convergence or quality benchmark.
+
+Use --reference-transport for an independent identity-based feature/gradient
+oracle in the same native model layout. Its broadcasts are test-only.
+"""
+
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from examples.mimo import pretrain_mimo
+from examples.mimo.data.source_batch import SourceBatchIterator
+from examples.mimo.model_providers import MimoProvider
+from examples.mimo.training import builder
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_layer_specs import (
+    get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec,
+    get_gpt_mtp_block_spec,
+)
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_model import GPTModel
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.planning import MediaTask, assign_media_to_producers
+from megatron.core.models.mimo.submodules.vision import VisionModalitySubmodules
+from megatron.core.models.vision.clip_vit_model import CLIPViTModel
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+from megatron.training import get_args
+from megatron.training.arguments import core_transformer_config_from_args
+from megatron.training.global_vars import get_run_config, get_train_state
+
+
+def language_spec(args, pg_collection, grid):
+    """Two real MoE GPT layers plus a MoE MTP layer, with explicit role groups."""
+    config = core_transformer_config_from_args(args)
+    config.use_cpu_initialization = True
+    experts = 16 if dist.get_world_size() == 20 else 4
+    assert (config.num_layers, config.hidden_size, config.num_moe_experts) == (2, 64, experts)
+    assert config.mtp_num_layers == 1
+    assert args.max_position_embeddings >= (1024 if experts == 16 else 512)
+    layer = get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec(num_experts=experts, moe_grouped_gemm=True)
+    return ModuleSpec(
+        GPTModel,
+        params=dict(
+            config=config,
+            transformer_layer_spec=layer,
+            mtp_block_spec=get_gpt_mtp_block_spec(config, layer, True, pp_rank=0),
+            vocab_size=256,
+            max_sequence_length=args.max_position_embeddings,
+            position_embedding_type="rope",
+            scatter_embedding_sequence_parallel=False,
+            share_embeddings_and_output_weights=False,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def encoder_spec(args, pg_collection, grid):
+    """One real CLIP layer; each 16x16 image produces five feature rows."""
+    config = TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=1,
+        hidden_size=64,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        ffn_hidden_size=128,
+        bf16=True,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        use_cpu_initialization=True,
+        hidden_dropout=0,
+        attention_dropout=0,
+    )
+    return ModuleSpec(
+        VisionModalitySubmodules,
+        params={"pg_collection": pg_collection},
+        submodules={
+            "encoders": {
+                "clip": ModuleSpec(
+                    CLIPViTModel,
+                    params=dict(
+                        transformer_config=config,
+                        transformer_layer_spec=get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec(),
+                        img_h=16,
+                        img_w=16,
+                        patch_dim=8,
+                        pg_collection=pg_collection,
+                    ),
+                )
+            }
+        },
+    )
+
+
+class TinySourceDataset:
+    """Deterministic multi-image samples, with every seventh step text-only."""
+
+    def __init__(self, seed):
+        self.seed = seed
+
+    def build_global_batch(self, step, global_batch_size):
+        complex_pack = dist.get_world_size() == 20
+        assert global_batch_size == (4 if complex_pack else 8)
+        lengths = (768, 256, 512, 512) if complex_pack else (192, 128, 96, 64, 64, 32, 32, 32)
+        image_starts = (
+            ((48, 94, 144), (20, 30), (), ())
+            if complex_pack
+            else tuple(tuple(2 + 32 * i for i in range(n)) for n in (3, 2, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0))
+        )
+        samples, media = {}, []
+        for sid, length in enumerate(lengths):
+            logical = length - 3
+            tokens = (torch.arange(length) + 11 * sid + step % 3) % 127 + 1
+            labels = (tokens % 127) + 1
+            starts = image_starts[sid] if step % 7 != 6 else ()
+            ids = list(range(len(media), len(media) + len(starts)))
+            tokens[logical:] = labels[logical:] = 0
+            mask = torch.zeros(length)
+            mask[2:logical] = 1
+            for start in starts:
+                tokens[start : start + 5] = 255
+                mask[start : start + 5] = 0
+            samples[sid] = dict(
+                tokens=tokens,
+                labels=labels,
+                loss_mask=mask,
+                position_ids=torch.arange(logical),
+                original_seq_len=logical,
+                padded_seq_len=length,
+                media_ids=ids,
+            )
+            media.extend(
+                dict(
+                    image_id=mid,
+                    pixels=torch.randn(
+                        (3, 16, 16), generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(self.seed + mid)
+                    ),
+                )
+                for mid in ids
+            )
+        return samples, media
+
+
+def data_provider(args, topology):
+    """Native consumed-sample state determines the source batch after restart."""
+    config, state = get_run_config(), get_train_state()
+    train = SourceBatchIterator(
+        TinySourceDataset(config.rng.seed),
+        config.train.global_batch_size,
+        state.consumed_train_samples,
+    )
+    valid = (
+        SourceBatchIterator(
+            TinySourceDataset(config.rng.seed + 10000),
+            config.validation.eval_global_batch_size,
+            0 if config.validation.skip_train else state.consumed_valid_samples,
+        )
+        if config.validation.eval_iters
+        else None
+    )
+    return train, valid, None
+
+
+def prepare_source(source, *, args, topology):
+    """Only producer ranks materialize their assigned image tensors on CUDA."""
+    grid = topology.grids["images"]
+    producers = tuple(range(grid.rank_offset, grid.rank_offset + grid.size))
+    tasks = [MediaTask(item["image_id"], 5) for item in source["media"]]
+    assignments, slices = assign_media_to_producers(tasks, producers)
+    pixels = {item["image_id"]: item["pixels"] for item in source["media"]}
+    local_ids = [task.media_id for task in assignments.get(dist.get_rank(), ())]
+
+    def encoder_inputs(media_ids):
+        local = [pixels[mid] for mid in media_ids]
+        return {"images": {"clip": {"x": torch.stack(local).cuda().bfloat16()}}} if local else {}
+
+    inputs = (
+        encoder_inputs
+        if args.mimo_dcp_encoder_schedule == "per-round"
+        else encoder_inputs(local_ids)
+    )
+    return source["samples"], slices, inputs
+
+
+def provider(_args):
+    return MimoProvider(
+        encoder_module_names=("images",),
+        language_spec=language_spec,
+        encoder_specs={"images": encoder_spec},
+        special_token_ids=lambda args: {"images": 255},
+        build_communicator=lambda args, topology: None,
+        train_valid_test_data_provider=data_provider,
+        prepare_source=prepare_source,
+    )
+
+
+class IdentityFeatureReference:
+    """Tiny-fixture oracle independent of production feature slices and routes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, adapter):
+        assert dist.get_world_size() in (8, 20)
+        assert adapter.decoder_ranks == tuple(range(4, dist.get_world_size()))
+        self.adapter = adapter
+        prepare = adapter.prepare_source
+
+        def remember_source(source):
+            self.samples = source["samples"]
+            self.num_images = len(source["media"])
+            assert self.num_images in (0, 5 if dist.get_world_size() == 20 else 8)
+            assert [image["image_id"] for image in source["media"]] == list(range(self.num_images))
+            return prepare(source)
+
+        adapter.prepare_source = remember_source
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def forward(self, local_features, _plans, _cp_group, *, forward_only=False):
+        rank, hidden = dist.get_rank(), local_features.shape[-1]
+        table = local_features.new_zeros((8, 5, hidden))
+        # Equal-cost fixture media are assigned in ID order: producer=ID%4,
+        # producer-local row offset=(ID//4)*5. No production route is consulted.
+        for producer in range(4):
+            count = len(range(producer, self.num_images, 4))
+            if count:
+                payload = (
+                    local_features.detach().reshape(count, 5, hidden).contiguous()
+                    if rank == producer
+                    else local_features.new_empty((count, 5, hidden))
+                )
+                dist.broadcast(payload, src=producer)
+                table[producer : self.num_images : 4].copy_(payload)
+        media_ids, features = (), None
+        if self.adapter.is_decoder:
+            item = self.adapter.plan.rounds[self.adapter.runtime.completed_rounds]
+            media_ids = tuple(
+                mid for sid in item.sample_ids for mid in self.samples[sid]["media_ids"]
+            )
+            features = table[list(media_ids)].reshape(-1, hidden).requires_grad_(not forward_only)
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            features=features,
+            local_features=local_features,
+            media_ids=media_ids,
+            num_images=self.num_images,
+            forward_only=forward_only,
+        )
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def backward(self, transfer):
+        assert not transfer.forward_only
+        hidden = transfer.local_features.shape[-1]
+        gradient = transfer.local_features.new_zeros((8, 5, hidden), dtype=torch.float32)
+        if transfer.features is not None and transfer.features.grad is not None:
+            rows = transfer.features.grad.reshape(-1, 5, hidden)
+            for image, contribution in zip(transfer.media_ids, rows):
+                gradient[image].add_(contribution.float())
+        dist.all_reduce(gradient)
+        if dist.get_rank() < 4 and transfer.num_images:
+            return (
+                gradient[dist.get_rank() : transfer.num_images : 4].reshape(-1, hidden).contiguous()
+            )
+        return torch.zeros_like(transfer.local_features, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # Replace only example wiring in this test process; use the unmodified native loop.
+    pretrain_mimo.resolve_provider = builder.resolve_provider = provider
+    reference_transport = "--reference-transport" in sys.argv
+    if reference_transport:
+        sys.argv.remove("--reference-transport")
+    native_build = builder.MimoModelBuilder.build_distributed_models
+
+    def build_fixture(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        models = native_build(self, *args, **kwargs)
+        assert len(models) == 1
+        adapter = models[0].mimo_packed_step
+        if reference_transport:
+            if get_args().mimo_dcp_encoder_schedule == "per-round":
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "The fixture's fixed-offset reference requires whole-step encoding"
+                )
+            adapter.runtime.bridge = IdentityFeatureReference(adapter)
+        if dist.get_world_size() == 20:
+            prepare = adapter.prepare
+
+            def prepare_complex(*args, **kwargs):
+                result = prepare(*args, **kwargs)
+                if adapter.is_decoder and adapter.model.config.dynamic_context_parallel:
+                    assert len(adapter.plan.rounds) == 1
+                    item = adapter.plan.rounds[0]
+                    assert [plan.cp_ranks for plan in item.feature_plans] == [
+                        tuple(range(4, 12)),
+                        tuple(range(12, 16)),
+                        tuple(range(16, 20)),
+                    ]
+                    rank = dist.get_rank()
+                    assert item.sample_ids == ((0, 1) if rank < 12 else (2,) if rank < 16 else (3,))
+                return result
+
+            models[0].config.sequence_packing_data_adapter = prepare_complex
+        return models
+
+    builder.MimoModelBuilder.build_distributed_models = build_fixture
+    pretrain_mimo.main()

+"""CPU contracts for the ordinary schedulers over the full GTP data domain.
+
+Run directly with Python without importing the CUDA-backed Megatron package.
+The AST loader executes the production scheduler definitions unchanged.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import random
+import unittest
+from collections import Counter
+from functools import lru_cache
+from math import ceil, log2
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
+
+
+def _load_schedulers():
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+    selections = {
+        'megatron/core/context_parallel/groups.py': (
+            'get_valid_dynamic_context_parallel_group_sizes',
+        ),
+        'megatron/core/datasets/data_schedule_utils.py': (
+            'get_packed_sequence_length',
+            'next_hdp_group_packing_aware',
+            'align_sample_id_groups',
+        ),
+        'megatron/core/datasets/data_schedule.py': (
+            'BasePackingScheduler',
+            'DpBalancedScheduler',
+            'DefaultDynamicCPScheduler',
+        ),
+    }
+    namespace = dict(globals(), _DYNAMIC_CP_WORKLOAD_CAP_DELTA=0.05)
+    for filename, names in selections.items():
+        path = root / filename
+        source = path.read_text()
+        nodes = [node for node in ast.parse(source).body if getattr(node, 'name', None) in names]
+        assert {node.name for node in nodes} == set(names)
+        selected = 'from __future__ import annotations\n' + '\n\n'.join(
+            ast.get_source_segment(source, node) for node in nodes
+        )
+        exec(compile(selected, str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
+        namespace['parallel_state'] = SimpleNamespace(
+            get_valid_dynamic_context_parallel_group_sizes=namespace[
+                'get_valid_dynamic_context_parallel_group_sizes'
+            ]
+        )
+    return namespace
+
+
+_SCHEDULERS = _load_schedulers()
+
+
+class TestFullDomainGTPScheduling(unittest.TestCase):
+    def schedule(self, lengths, ranks, dynamic=True, multiple=None, capacity=1024):
+        cp_size = 2
+        cls = _SCHEDULERS['DefaultDynamicCPScheduler' if dynamic else 'DpBalancedScheduler']
+        scheduler = cls(capacity, cp_size, ranks // cp_size, multiple)
+        result = scheduler.get_groups_and_subsamples(list(enumerate(lengths)))
+        seen = Counter()
+        used_groups = set()
+        for row in result:
+            self.assertEqual(len(row), ranks)
+            self.assertTrue(all(row))
+            groups = {}
+            for rank, ids in enumerate(row):
+                groups.setdefault(tuple(ids), []).append(rank)
+            for ids, members in groups.items():
+                size = len(members)
+                allowed_sizes = (
+                    _SCHEDULERS['get_valid_dynamic_context_parallel_group_sizes'](ranks)
+                    if dynamic
+                    else [cp_size]
+                )
+                self.assertIn(size, allowed_sizes)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    members, list(range(members[0] // size * size, (members[0] // size + 1) * size))
+                )
+                used_groups.add(tuple(members))
+                for sid in ids:
+                    seen[sid] += 1
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        [rank for rank, pack in enumerate(row) if sid in pack], members
+                    )
+                # Inputs are physical padded lengths; zigzag's per-sequence
+                # rounding and CP-local alignment must still fit capacity.
+                seq_alignment = 2 * size if size > 1 else 1
+                physical = sum(ceil(lengths[sid] / seq_alignment) * seq_alignment for sid in ids)
+                self.assertLessEqual(ceil(physical / size), capacity)
+        self.assertEqual(seen, Counter({sid: 1 for sid in range(len(lengths))}))
+        if multiple:
+            self.assertEqual(len(result) % multiple, 0)
+        return result, used_groups
+
+    def test_four_gpu_asymmetry_uses_original_scheduler_in_five_rounds(self):
+        lengths = [128] * 8 + [2048] * 8
+        for dynamic in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(dynamic=dynamic):
+                result, _ = self.schedule(lengths, 4, dynamic=dynamic)
+                self.assertEqual(len(result), 5)
+
+    def test_eight_gpu_g2_replica2_asymmetry(self):
+        lengths = [128] * 16 + [2048] * 16
+        for dynamic in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(dynamic=dynamic):
+                result, _ = self.schedule(lengths, 8, dynamic=dynamic)
+                self.assertEqual(len(result), 5)
+
+    def test_runtime_cp_crosses_gtp_coordinates(self):
+        for ranks in (4, 8):
+            with self.subTest(ranks=ranks):
+                _, groups = self.schedule([ranks * 1024] + [128] * 16, ranks)
+                self.assertIn(tuple(range(ranks)), groups)
+
+    def test_eight_gpu_cp4_groups_are_full_domain_contiguous(self):
+        _, groups = self.schedule([4096, 4096] + [128] * 16, 8)
+        self.assertIn((0, 1, 2, 3), groups)
+        self.assertIn((4, 5, 6, 7), groups)
+
+    def test_vpp_alignment_uses_public_scheduler(self):
+        for ranks in (4, 8):
+            for dynamic in (False, True):
+                with self.subTest(ranks=ranks, dynamic=dynamic):
+                    self.schedule([128] * 16 + [1024] * 16, ranks, dynamic, multiple=2)
+
+    def test_static_alignment_can_take_a_sample_from_first_pack(self):
+        # CP2, G2: one sample per data owner is a complete fixed-size batch.
+        result, _ = self.schedule([8, 8], 4, dynamic=False, capacity=8)
+        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1)
+
+    def test_varied_lengths_conserve_samples_and_match_runtime_groups(self):
+        rng = random.Random(20261026)
+        for ranks in (4, 8):
+            for case in range(40):
+                lengths = [rng.randrange(1, 65) * 16 for _ in range(rng.randrange(8, 65))]
+                with self.subTest(ranks=ranks, case=case):
+                    self.schedule(lengths, ranks)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
